facts.value: The reset zeros only the enumerated counters, arrays, and flags, not x5B8[4] or guaranteed padding bytes. Initialization sets unk_804D6480 to 1. Allocation returns the pre-state and advances the stored u16, replacing wrapped zero with 1: pre-state 65535 returns 65535 and leaves 1; pre-state zero returns zero and leaves 1. Reset and wrap can reuse identifiers.

This demonstrates occurrence-sensitive allocation, not a universal guarantee against repeated-frame counting.
